description: This PHP class 'EmployeeJobController' manages employee job-related data and permissions within the OrangeHRM system, including services for job titles, categories, company structure, employment status, and locations, and prepares data for rendering employee job views.

classes.name: EmployeeJobController
classes.description: Controller class for managing employee job details, including data retrieval and permission setting for employee job views.

methods.name: getJobTitleService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the JobTitleService instance.

methods.name: getJobCategoryService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the JobCategoryService instance.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the CompanyStructureService instance.

methods.name: getEmploymentStatusService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the EmploymentStatusService instance.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the LocationService instance.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and permissions for rendering the employee job view based on the employee number from the request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups required for capability permission checks.
